content.value_statement: Teams need structured privacy compliance reviews across GDPR and German DSGVO obligations. This skill guides assessments, DPIA planning, rights workflows, audit preparation, and governance checks.
actual_capabilities: Maps GDPR and DSGVO compliance areas from legal basis through international transfers.
Outlines DPIA threshold checks, execution steps, documentation, and review tasks.
Structures data subject rights intake, verification, fulfillment, and response documentation.
Supports audit planning, legal compliance checks, reporting, and remediation planning.
Covers DPO support, privacy governance, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
Includes healthcare and medical-device data protection considerations.
limitations: Does not replace qualified legal counsel or supervisory authority guidance.
Bundled scripts, references, and assets are placeholders, not finished automation.
Does not verify live regulatory updates unless the host model checks current sources.
Requires organization-specific records, contracts, systems, and technical evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare an internal privacy audit
use_cases.description: Build an audit scope, evidence request list, and finding structure for GDPR and DSGVO controls.

use_cases.title: Plan a DPIA for new processing
use_cases.description: Assess whether a DPIA is needed and define risk, mitigation, and documentation steps.

use_cases.title: Review German DSGVO obligations
use_cases.description: Check German-specific privacy requirements alongside EU GDPR obligations for a business process.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our privacy program for basic GDPR and DSGVO readiness. Use the details below and list gaps by priority: [context].

prompt_templates.title: Map Processing Obligations
prompt_templates.prompt: Map the GDPR obligations for this processing activity. Cover legal basis, notices, rights, retention, processors, transfers, and records: [activity].

prompt_templates.title: Build a DPIA Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DPIA plan for this high-risk processing. Include threshold analysis, risks, mitigations, stakeholders, and documentation needs: [processing details].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Audit Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a GDPR and DSGVO audit strategy for this organization. Include scope, evidence requests, control tests, risk ranking, and remediation planning: [organization context].

output_examples.input: Assess GDPR readiness for a German SaaS product that processes analytics and support data.
output: Readiness summary with high, medium, and low priority gaps.
Checks for legal basis, notices, processor terms, rights handling, retention, and transfers.
Remediation steps for product, legal, security, and support owners.

output_examples.input: Plan a DPIA for a connected medical device that processes patient data.
output: Risk register themes for health data, transfers, access controls, and patient rights.
Mitigation plan with documentation and stakeholder review steps.

output_examples.input: Prepare for a supervisory authority audit after a privacy complaint.
output: Audit readiness checklist for records, notices, DPIAs, processor contracts, and complaint handling.
Evidence request plan and communication roles.
Issue log structure with corrective actions and owners.

best_practices: Provide processing purpose, data categories, parties, transfers, retention, and existing controls.
Separate legal questions from technical implementation evidence when requesting analysis.
Validate final conclusions with counsel, DPOs, and current supervisory authority guidance.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated guidance as a final legal opinion.
Do not request a compliance verdict without supplying processing details and evidence.
Do not use the placeholder helper files as production automation.

faq.question: Is this skill legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured compliance guidance that should be reviewed by qualified counsel or a DPO.

faq.question: Does it cover German DSGVO requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes German-specific DSGVO and BDSG considerations alongside EU GDPR topics.

faq.question: Can it create a DPIA plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline threshold checks, risks, mitigations, stakeholders, and documentation steps.

faq.question: Can it automate compliance checks?
faq.answer: Not in this package. The included scripts and assets are placeholders and should not be used as automation.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide processing records, data flows, system descriptions, contracts, retention rules, and current controls.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
